About ERA Interior

Materials that make a space feel alive

ERA Interior brings premium materials, modern design and lasting quality together. We supply natural and engineered products for homes, offices, hotels, showrooms and outdoor areas.

From natural stone and IPE decking to wallpaper, carpet and soffit panels, you get flooring, cladding, wall, ceiling and outdoor solutions from one trusted source.
